1. Supervise daily hatchery activities according to work plans and SOPs.

2. Monitor breeding, larval rearing, nursery operations, and water quality.

3. Guide and coordinate operators and hatchery workers.

4. Ensure compliance with biosecurity, quality, safety, and hygiene standards.

5. Report abnormalities, mortality spikes, or operational issues.

6. Maintain daily operational records.

Qualifications:

• Minimum Diploma (D3) or Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Fisheries, Aquatic Cultivation, Aquaculture, or a related field.
• Experience in hatcheries, fry production, or fish/shrimp larval production is an advantage.
• Understanding of larval rearing techniques, live feed culture, and water quality management.
• Ability to monitor larval health, record production data, and implement biosecurity measures.
• Willingness to work shifts; high attention to detail; ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
• Willingness to be stationed in the Sumbawa area.

1. Mengawasi aktivitas operasional hatchery sehari-hari sesuai dengan rencana kerja dan SOP yang berlaku.

2. Memantau proses pemijahan, pemeliharaan larva, pendederan (nursery), serta kualitas air.

3. Membimbing dan mengoordinasikan operator serta pekerja hatchery.

4. Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar biosekuriti, kualitas, keselamatan kerja, dan kebersihan.

5. Melaporkan setiap ketidaksesuaian, peningkatan mortalitas, atau permasalahan operasional yang terjadi.

6. Memelihara dan memastikan kelengkapan pencatatan operasional harian.

Kualifikasi:

• Minimal Diploma (D3) atau Sarjana (S1) Perikanan, Budidaya Perairan, Akuakultur, atau bidang terkait.
• Memiliki pengalaman di bidang hatchery, produksi benih, atau produksi larva ikan/udang menjadi nilai tambah.
• Memahami teknik pemeliharaan larva, kultur pakan alami, dan manajemen kualitas air.
• Mampu melakukan monitoring kesehatan larva, pencatatan data produksi, serta penerapan biosekuriti.
• Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift, memiliki ketelitian tinggi, serta mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.
• Bersedia ditempatkan di wilayah Sumbawa.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
